digest.component_or_area: rebar project extension framework code-review criterion
propositions: A single-turn code-review project criterion must enforce phase boundaries: Pass 1 discovers only grounded findings without validity/impact/severity assessment, drop/block policy, or remediation instruction.

Pass 2 must verify validity and impact atomically without discovering new findings, deciding outcomes, or prescribing fixes; Pass 3 must apply deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment; Pass 4 must offer non-prescriptive guidance without re-verification or implementation prescription.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire, RP-N1..RP-N6 must abstain) must achieve across three runs: recall 1.0, false-accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, minimum per-case stability ≥2/3, and Cohen kappa ≥0.70.

The criterion implementation must be entirely project-owned, changing only .rebar/ prompt/routing/eval assets, .gitignore exceptions, criterion-specific tests, and the docs/llm-framework.md dogfood subsection.
